${mod_id}.settings.title: §l${mod_name}
${mod_id}.settings.enable_mod.tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off. While it is off, the voice mods show their own HUD icons again.
${mod_id}.settings.plasmo_voice.tooltip: Show players talking through Plasmo Voice. Its own talking list on the HUD is hidden while this is on.
${mod_id}.settings.simple_voice_chat.too: Show players talking through Simple Voice Chat. Its group HUD is hidden while this is on.
${mod_id}.settings.display_mode.tooltip:
Faces in a Row / Column: players side by side or one under another.
List: rows with head, name and a speaker icon.
Subtitles: lines in Minecraft's own subtitles, with direction arrows.
Locator Bar: player heads grow out of the Locator Bar dots.
${mod_id}.settings.position.tooltip: Screen edge or corner to put the HUD in. Dragging the HUD moves it freely.
${mod_id}.settings.face_size.tooltip: Size of the player heads in pixels. Scrolling over the preview changes it too.
${mod_id}.settings.max_shown.tooltip: How many players are shown at once. The rest are summed up as +N.
${mod_id}.settings.show_self.tooltip: Also show yourself while you talk.
${mod_id}.settings.show_names.tooltip: Show player names under their heads. The List always shows names.
${mod_id}.settings.fade_time.tooltip: How long a player stays on the HUD, fading out, after they stop talking.
${mod_id}.settings.animation.tooltip:
How the player head moves while they talk, following the voice volume:
Pulse: the head grows with the voice.
Rings: square rings ripple out from the head.
Bounce: the head hops with the voice.
${mod_id}.settings.highlight.tooltip: A glow and frame around the player head in the chosen color, brighter while they talk.
${mod_id}.settings.color.tooltip: Color of the highlight and animations. Player Color gives everyone their own color, the same as their dot on the Locator Bar.
${mod_id}.settings.background.tooltip: Opacity of the dark background behind List rows and name labels.
${mod_id}.settings.reset_position.toolti: Moves the HUD back to its default spot, top center.
${mod_id}.settings.done.tooltip: Saves the settings and closes the screen.
